title: Extending a marked span
statement: Let $\ell,h,p\in\mathbb{Z}$ with $\ell\le h$ and $\ell-1\le p\le h+1$. Updating the closed-span marker for $[\ell,h]$ to hold $\mathrm{true}$ at $p$ gives the closed-span marker for $[\min(\ell,p),\max(h,p)]$.
replaced:
Let $\ell \le h$ be integers and let $p$ be a cell with $\ell - 1 \le p \le h + 1$.
Writing the mark at $p$ on the closed-span marker for $[\ell, h]$ yields the closed-span
marker for $[\min(\ell,p), \max(h,p)]$.
